slides.dek: We gave five animals a review form. Your roommate did not survive.

slides.name: The Dog
slides.meta: Has never had a bad day
slides.title: Best friend I've ever seen
slides.body: They eat cereal for dinner and share the box. Incredible loyalty. Incredible smell. Five stars, would live here forever.

slides.name: The Pigeon
slides.title: Free real estate energy
slides.body: They leave the balcony door open for fresh air. I have never paid rent and never will. Legendary hospitality.

slides.name: The Goldfish
slides.title: Wait, do I live here too
slides.body: Someone keeps rearranging the furniture. I wake up in a new apartment every day. Confusing. Also possibly exciting.

slides.name: The Owl
slides.title: The 2am dishes are unacceptable
slides.body: The clattering begins precisely when I am trying to work. I have written a formal complaint. It has three citations. None real.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.title: The other human is loud
slides.body: Footsteps at every hour. Doors that close wrong. One star. I have already started planning my next lease. Theirs.
Send this to the roommate who never replaces the toilet paper.
